firecrawl.description: Catalog of structured data providers (transcripts, segment KPIs, analyst ratings, options activity, filing sections, FedWatch, positioning, alternative data) plus web search, scrape, map and crawl from code. Paid per call.
firecrawl.instruction: For data: alexandria_library_search(command=...) runs read-only shell commands (ls, grep, cat) over the catalog, one contract per capability at /library/<category>/<provider>/<capability>.md naming its inputs (free); alexandria_library_read(calls=[{"provider", "capability", "options"}]) runs up to 10 of them (paid). Prefer the built-in market data servers when they cover the request; use this catalog for what they do not. Read skills/data-catalog/ before first use, for prices. For web pages in code: firecrawl_scrape(url=...), firecrawl_search, firecrawl_map, firecrawl_crawl. Every call except alexandria_library_search is charged to the user, and the run's result reports the cost.
